# coreweave_iam_service_account_oidc_trust_config (Data Source)

> **Private beta:** This data source is available only to organizations enrolled in the private beta and may change before general availability. It is gated by an organization-level feature flag. Contact your CoreWeave representative or CoreWeave Support to request access for your organization.

Looks up an existing OIDC trust configuration belonging to a CoreWeave service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coreweave_iam_service_account_oidc_trust_config" "github_actions" {
  organization_id    = "a1b2c3"
  service_account_id = "ci-agent"
  id                 = "github-actions"
}

output "trust_config_uid" {
  value = data.coreweave_iam_service_account_oidc_trust_config.github_actions.uid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The caller-chosen trust configuration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) The six-character ID of the owning CoreWeave organization.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account that owns this trust configuration.

### Read-Only

- `cel` (String) The CEL expression evaluated against verified OIDC token claims exposed through the `token` namespace.
- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) The optional description of the trust rule.
- `name` (String) The canonical resource name.
- `uid` (String) The server-generated unique identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The RFC 3339 last-update timestamp.
- `workload_federation_oidc_config_id` (String) The UID of the workload federation OIDC configuration used to verify tokens.
